offers_products.reason: Sells plasma collection devices, disposables, Cell Saver, TEG analyzers, VASCADE vascular closure systems and software.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from devices, disposables and software; support and service are incidental to the products sold.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are plasma centers, blood centers and hospitals; patients and donors do not purchase.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to plasma collectors, blood centers and hospitals, including cath labs and surgical departments.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is repeat orders of disposables, such as plasma collection sets and vascular closure devices, used per procedure.

cyclical_demand.reason: Plasma collection, blood management and cardiac procedures are medically needed and not easily postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Mainly small, frequent disposable purchases; capital devices are a smaller part of sales.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for proprietary medical devices, disposables and software, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large plasma collectors, such as big fractionators, plus hospital systems and blood banks.

asset_heavy.reason: Medical device maker with moderate manufacturing needs. It isn't a fleet, network or property business.
